preparation.title: Where every non-combat item comes from
preparation.text: 12 magic logs: use the logs set aside during Woodcutting or Wintertodt and withdraw the twelve noted for Eblis . If fewer remain, cut the missing logs at 75 Woodcutting; the opening Woodcutting step explains where to train if you need those levels. This quest spends twelve of the chapter's thirteen-log allocation; keep the last log banked for Mourning's End Part I. Chapter 3.1's While Guthix Sleeps supplies the later MM2 balloon logs from its storeroom loot. 6 steel bars + 1 iron bar: check the bank after clockworks, other quests and smithing. At 30 Smithing, smelt six iron ore with twelve coal into steel at an ordinary furnace; make the separate iron bar at 15 Smithing, allowing for failed iron smelts. Mine the ore or buy it from Ordan in Keldagrim. Six iron ore alone is not six steel bars. Withdraw the six steel bars noted for Eblis ; keep the separate iron bar for the boots stage. 6 molten glass: withdraw the reserved glass as one noted stack of six molten glass for Eblis . It must remain molten glass. If it was blown into something else, replace it with six fresh buckets of sand and six soda ash from a charter trader, smelted at a furnace at 1 Crafting. Unpowered orbs cannot be converted back into glass. 1 silver bar: a fresh bar after Shadow of the Storm, Nature Spirit, Fenkenstrain and Animal Magnetism. Buy the shortfall from the East Ardougne Silver Merchant; keep this bar separate from the ones used in those earlier quests. Ashes / bones / blood rune: burn a normal log and collect its ashes; kill a chicken for ordinary bones; if already at 63 Magic, drink a Wizard's mind bomb to enter the 66-Magic Wizards' Guild in Yanille and buy a blood rune upstairs; otherwise buy it from Ali Morrisane after The Feud and Rogue Trader's rune-shop puzzle, or Lundail's shop using 1.3's bank-first Wilderness approach. Wait for a restock or try another world if the blood rune is sold out. Charcoal / garlic powder / spice / sweet: buy charcoal from Jiminua north-west of Tai Bwo Wannai, take garlic from the cupboard upstairs in Morgan's Draynor house and grind it, buy spice from Ardougne's spice seller, and buy a chocolate bar from the Grand Tree groceries. Keep that sweet separate from chocolate dust used in energy potions. Boots: take one spare climbing-boot pair from Death Plateau, or buy it from Tenzing for 12 coins. Bring it and the separate iron bar to Dunstan in Burthorpe for spiked boots when the ice-path stage calls for them. Keep an ordinary climbing pair available for mountain travel. Desert entry: Shantay at the pass south of Al Kharid sells passes and filled waterskins. Buy passes for the gate crossings you actually plan to make, or use an existing desert-entry bypass; carry waterskins for exposed walks. Keep carpet fares separate from the 650-coin Bandit Camp pub payment, and refill travel supplies before another desert trip. Gas mask / tinderbox / lockpicks: use Plague City's mask; reclaim it from the cupboard in Edmond's house if lost. Buy a tinderbox from a general store. At the route's 50+ Agility/Thieving, buy lockpicks from Martin Thwait in the Rogues' Den beneath Burthorpe's Toad and Chicken . Start with about 50 and replenish if unlucky; this is a buffer, not a guaranteed lock count. Bring antipoison and food for the trapped chest. The archaeologist/Rasolo and other quest NPCs supply the etchings, translation, visibility ring, keys and diamonds during their respective stages. For Dessous, first ask Malak in the Canifis pub how to kill him ; Ruantun will not make the pot before that dialogue. Then take the silver bar to Ruantun in Draynor Sewers for the silver pot , bank weapons/armour for Entrana and have its High Priest bless it, return to Malak for blood, and add the garlic powder and ordinary spice. Check that the finished pot contains blood, garlic and spices before going to the graveyard. Bank completed diamonds between trips. Keep the gas mask equipped throughout the Smoke Dungeon .

preparation.title: Prayer, restore, energy and antipoison: recipes and quantities
preparation.text: Count doses and missing ingredients now. A normal Herblore craft makes three doses . Decant by using matching potions on one another, or ask Bob Barter at the Grand Exchange to decant to four-dose vials; decanting changes bottles, not the total doses. Water-filled vials are sold individually or in packs by Aemad in East Ardougne and Herblore shops. Prayer potion — 38 Herblore: clean ranarr + vial of water + snape grass. For the nine prayer(4) planning stock below, twelve crafts use 12 ranarrs, 12 snape grass and 12 water-filled vials and make 36 doses . Count your ingredients and pick any missing grass on the hobgoblin peninsula west of the Crafting Guild , outside the guild; bring food and a Falador/bank teleport. Farming snape grass is not required. Reserve Eadgar's separate ranarr first if that quest is unfinished. Ordinary restore — 22 Herblore: clean harralander + vial of water + red spiders' eggs . For the separate troll and Kamil trips, start by making 6 restore(3) = 18 doses , requiring 6 harralanders and 6 eggs . Reserve 12 doses = 3 restore(4) for the Kamil boss trip; the other six doses are the opening troll-trip pool. After decanting the full stock, that is four restore(4) plus one restore(2). Refill anything consumed before taking the full boss reserve. These restore drained combat stats including Magic, but not Prayer, Hitpoints or Agility . Keep the additional Heroes' Quest harralander banked. Missing eggs: enter Varrock Sewers through the manhole east of Varrock Palace , follow the sewer west to the moss-giant/deadly-red-spider end, and pick the red-spiders'-eggs ground spawns. Bring a knife or slash weapon for webs, food and a bank teleport. Pick up respawns until you have the six missing eggs; killing the spiders is unnecessary. At 51 Agility , the pipe near Vannaka connects Edgeville Dungeon to these sewers as an alternative. Stay out of Edgeville's separate Wilderness section. Energy potion — 26 Herblore: clean harralander + water-filled vial + chocolate dust. Use already-made energy potions first; otherwise buy chocolate bars from Heckel Funch in the Grand Tree and crush them with a pestle and mortar. Each new energy potion needs an additional herb after the six restore herbs and Heroes' reserve. For an opening travel/kiting buffer from zero, make three energy(3) from three additional herbs and three chocolate dust: decant eight doses into two energy(4), leaving one spare dose. Walking while run energy regenerates and banking between legs reduces demand; replace only what you use. Antipoison — 5 Herblore: buy ordinary antipoison(3) directly from Jiminua's Jungle Store , or mix clean marrentill + water-filled vial + unicorn horn dust. If making it, kill a unicorn south of Varrock and grind its horn. Start with two three-dose bottles in the bank, taking one for the trapped chest/pyramid legs and replacing it if spent. If herbs are missing: use banked clean/grimy herbs and suitable already-planted herbs first. For an immediate repeatable source, take combat gear, food and a Falador/bank teleport to Taverley Dungeon's chaos druids near the entrance, kill them for herb drops and bank until you have the missing herbs. This is a random drop hunt, not a promised number of kills. Do not process every harralander into energy potions before reserving the restore ingredients. You can use this source without waiting for Farming-contract seed rewards. Super restores are different: they need 63 Herblore, snapdragon and red spiders' eggs and restore Prayer as well as drained stats. Ordinary restores and prayer potions are separate supplies. Both recipes are available once you have 38 Herblore ; there is no 63-Herblore detour for this quest. How much to bring: bank the full available prayer stock, then take the per-boss amounts below. With that nine-bottle planning stock, keep four prayer(4) earmarked for the ice-troll/Kamil attempt and use the other five as a starting pool for the remaining legs. Amounts depend on damage, prayer bonus, mistakes and retries; if the bank falls below the next leg's buffer, replenish it before entering. Replenish an insufficient potion bank before the next leg rather than relying on learning flicking during the quest. What BRUHsailer does: its Chapter 1.4 Edgeville/Varrock-sewers stop collects about seven eggs , shared between diary uses, DT restores and Guthix balance. It later explicitly spends prayer potions and death runes on DT, alongside high-attention boss methods. If you followed that pickup, check how many eggs remain after other uses. Gather more from the sewers until you have the six needed for these restores. BRUHsailer source .

preparation.title: Runes, food and a bankable starting kit
preparation.text: Use the standard spellbook for the four bosses. Buy only missing air/water/fire/mind/chaos/death runes from Aubury in Varrock or Betty in Port Sarim; refill coins with the established Thieving method if needed. Buy elemental staffs from Zaff in Varrock. The MTA rune purchases are already partly spent, and the 100-chaos-rune Chapter 2 reserve must remain after DT. Starting rune supply: prepare roughly 200 casts per boss , then restock before a retry if you run low. Fire Bolt needs 1 chaos + 3 air + 4 fire per cast (35 Magic); a fire staff covers fire runes. Water Bolt needs 1 chaos + 2 air + 2 water (23 Magic). For the no-gloves Fareed method, carry all three rune types even if you start with a staff. Higher water spells are an option if you have the level/runes, but do not make the plan depend on a staff staying equipped. Fire Bolt is deliberately low enough to survive some Kamil stat drain. Wear ordinary Magic gear already obtained: elemental staff, wizard hat/robes and an amulet of magic, with available defensive pieces that do not ruin spell accuracy. Chaos gauntlets from the completed Family Crest improve bolt spells if you select that enchantment; normal family/goldsmith/cooking gauntlets do not give the bolt bonus. Existing gear is sufficient preparation; there is no required Mystic, Barrows, Graceful or stamina grind. For boss trips, use cooked swordfish or better banked food . If the food bank is empty, harpoon swordfish/tuna at Catherby at 50 Fishing, cook them at your 60 Cooking and keep going until the next inventory is filled; buy the harpoon from Harry. Take roughly 12–16 food after the current leg's potions/runes/quest items, plus a charged bank teleport. Kamil needs an item teleport such as a ring of dueling in the inventory, since drained Magic can disable teleport spells. Bank between bosses and refill Prayer at an altar before each trip.

preparation.title: Fareed: water spells, the glove tooltip and optional kiting
preparation.text: Quest Helper's wording is about your weapon hand. Without ice gloves, Fareed can unequip your weapon when he reaches you. That includes a water staff: having water runes supplied by the staff does not protect the staff. The direct no-gloves plan is to enter with the weapon slot empty and manually cast water spells with all their air, water and catalytic runes in inventory . Bank the staff for this method; if you choose to wield one initially, leave a free inventory slot for it when disarmed. Water spells are the damaging Magic option here; gloves do not make Iban Blast or a fire spell work. Keep the gas mask on. Take 1–2 prayer(4) , food and water-spell runes; leave Protect from Melee on when he can reach you and eat through occasional other damage. For the lower-damage alternative, bring energy potions, cast once and run around the room to keep distance. If he catches you, the three inventory rune stacks still let you keep manual casting. Banking/retrying is preferable to running out of water runes mid-fight. Optional glove route: at 50 Mining, take a pickaxe, food, combat supplies and a teleport through White Wolf Mountain to the Ice Queen's lair, defeat her and collect ice gloves . Starting Heroes' Quest is not required. They let you keep a staff equipped for water-spell autocast. Smiths gloves (i) are the Giants' Foundry gloves combined with ice gloves; plain smiths gloves and goldsmith gauntlets do not substitute. There is no reason to grind the Foundry outfit just for Fareed. Ice Queen route .

preparation.title: Damis: establish the rat or bat block, then cast
preparation.text: Take the ring of visibility, runes, food, a bank teleport and 2 prayer(4) as a setup/recovery buffer. Damis's second form drains Prayer rapidly when it reaches you; a larger potion stack alone is an awkward answer to that mechanic. Use the rat/bat block: keep a rat or giant bat alive in the arena, turn auto-retaliate off, and lure it between you and Damis so he cannot reach melee range. Set up while the first form is alive; use a weak hit only if needed to get the blocker following you. Leave Protect from Melee on during the lure. Once the blocker is actually holding Damis and you are taking no attacks, cast from that position and turn prayer off. Keep the block for the second form; do not run so far away that the encounter resets. If the blocker moves or dies, put Protect from Melee back on and re-establish it or teleport. The technique saves supplies through positioning; it does not require flicking. Use the current Damis positioning illustration for the exact layout instead of guessing a tile from a textual direction.

preparation.title: Dessous: keep one overhead on and budget food
preparation.text: Bring the completed blessed blood mixture, combat runes, 2 prayer(4) , plenty of food and a teleport. The relaxed default is to stand in melee range and leave Protect from Melee on while using Magic and eating through the other attack. Do not kite around the graveyard fence as though it were a permanent safespot: repeated Dessous teleports can end the encounter and cost another blood mixture. BRUHsailer's alternating Melee/Missiles prayer trick is an optional high-attention method, separate from basic lazy flicking. It is not a requirement for this route. If you leave or fail the fight, keep the blessed pot, return to Malak for fresh blood and rebuild the garlic/spice mixture before another attempt; having the old empty pot is not the same as having a usable summon mixture.

preparation.title: Kamil: separate troll trip, Fire Bolt and ordinary restores
preparation.text: Clear the five ice trolls first. Bring the child's sweet, climbing boots, food, prayer potions, Fire Bolt runes and the six-dose ordinary-restore pool . The cold drains stats on this trip too; use restores to keep Fire Bolt available. The five kills persist, so leave and bank after opening the way. Refill anything used until you again have the full 4 prayer(4) + 3 restore(4) boss inventory below, fresh food, full Prayer and restored stats. If more than the opening restore pool was needed for trolls, make the additional potions before returning. For the boss trip: take about 4 prayer(4), 3 ordinary restore(4) , Fire Bolt runes, a fire staff, food, spiked boots for the path afterwards and an item-based emergency teleport. Two rings of recoil are useful extra damage: make two sapphire rings from two additional gold bars/sapphires and enchant each with 1 cosmic + 1 water rune at 7 Magic; equip one and carry the spare. They are separate from teleport-jewellery reserves, and the fight does not depend on owning them. Get him into melee range and leave Protect from Melee on. On the approach, Protect from Magic can cover the initial magic hits; once close, switch to Melee. That is one situational switch, not continuous flicking. Keep casting Fire Bolt . His freezes can interrupt attacking, so re-click the spell/boss or resume autocast when control returns. Watch current Magic and Prayer separately. Drink an ordinary restore before Magic falls below Fire Bolt's 35 requirement; drink a prayer dose to maintain the overhead. Cold keeps draining stats throughout the fight; use the current spell-level requirement as the restoration threshold. Eat early enough to survive the next hit. If the first attempt is consuming the supplies faster than expected, teleport while you still can, replenish and retry. After the kill: collect the dropped food and super restore , then continue the ice path wearing spiked boots. The dropped super restore can restore the Agility that ordinary restores could not; save it for the path after the fight. Keep food for falls and the remaining cold damage, and retain fire-spell runes to break the ice around both parents at the end. The old rock/player-block Kamil methods are not the default because their reliability depends on positioning and changed encounter behaviour. Use the direct fire-spell plan and leave any flick practice for an easier enemy.

preparation.title: Learn lazy flicking separately with RuneLite timing aids
preparation.text: RuneLite's built-in Prayer plugin can show the prayer-flick indicator on the prayer orb and the prayer-dose indicator. Its built-in Metronome gives an audible game-tick beat; start with one tick per beat at a comfortable volume. These are timing aids, not automatic prayer toggles, and the beat alone does not identify an enemy's attack phase. Practise on one weak melee enemy near an altar with auto-retaliate off: watch several attacks, turn Protect from Melee on before the next attack begins , leave it through that attack, then switch off during the gap. Do not wait for the damage number. If you lose the rhythm, leave prayer on. This lazy-flick practice is much easier to learn than rapid off/on clicks every 0.6-second tick, and you can finish DT before mastering either. Prayer plugin · Metronome .

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: With The Dig Site, The Tourist Trap, Troll Stronghold, Priest in Peril, Waterfall Quest and Temple of Ikov completed, the quest prerequisites are done. Check that you have 53 Thieving ; you may still be near the 50 trained in 1.2. If still short after the intervening quests, use Wealthy Citizens/house valuables or Ardougne Knights until you reach 53. Also confirm 50 Magic, 50 Firemaking, 10 Slayer and 43 Prayer ; 43 Prayer is this guide's combat preparation, not a quest-start requirement. The default is to leave the appropriate protection prayer on, bank between diamonds and use the boss-specific positioning below. One-tick flicking, alternating overheads every tick, ice gloves and super restores are not assumed. Ordinary restores solve Kamil's drained Magic; they do not restore Prayer. Prepare the two potion types separately before going to the ice area. Opening bank check: 12 magic logs, 6 steel bars, 6 molten glass, 1 ashes, 1 charcoal, 1 blood rune, 1 ordinary bones, 1 silver bar, garlic, pestle and mortar, spice, one chocolate bar/cake, climbing boots, 1 iron bar, gas mask, tinderbox, about 50 lockpicks, Shantay passes for any desert gate crossings, waterskins for desert walks, and at least 650 coins plus travel money. These are quest-wide supplies; withdraw only the current leg's items. Open the preparation notes before the first trip. Eblis departure: withdraw 12 magic logs, 6 steel bars and 6 molten glass as three noted stacks . Bring ashes, charcoal, one blood rune and ordinary bones alongside them. These materials use seven inventory slots , leaving room for coins, desert travel supplies, food and a teleport. Keep the thirteenth magic log banked for Mourning's End Part I . The glass must still be molten glass ; noting it does not mean crafting it into another item. Final pyramid: rebank the combat kit, bring all four diamonds, food, antipoison, some energy potions and a teleport, then place the diamonds and finish the pyramid. Traps can throw you back out; replenish used supplies before another run. Speak to Azzanadra for completion, then follow the Paddewwa step. Optional future pickup: bank one Trollweiss for Troll Romance if your ice-area route makes it convenient. Otherwise collect it with that quest's own setup later.

route_steps.review: Obtain 108 usable soft clay including existing stock. Use existing bracelets on Ancients or mine ordinary Isle of Souls clay and soften at the bank with one vial of water per clay, returning empty vials; use 14 clay plus 14 filled vials per clear inventory. Aemad supplies 100-vial packs; a refillable bucket at Edgeville well remains the alternative, since wells cannot fill empty vials directly. Reserve 216 laws for the tablets within a flexible 350–400 total bank target, leaving 134–184 for travel. Refill only the live gap from the Guild after Hand in the Sand and 66 effective Magic (63 plus mind bomb), or Ali's unlocked catalytic shop. Keep cash for cosmics and initial staves; 2.1 rechecks laws as alchs free cash. Paddewwa creation still requires Ancient Magicks at the Ancient Pyramid lectern. The 108 clay is a batch total and must be unnoted at the lectern. Use the Ruins of Unkah bank with 23 clay, two full waterskins, a Shantay pass and the two rune stacks per load; equip the fire staff. Four loads of 23 plus 16 require five visits. Buy passes and missing filled skins from Unkah's guard before loading; the pass is spent only when leaving for the desert. Walk north to the pyramid's southern shortcut, craft on Ancients, exit via the altar-room portal and walk back to bank without spending travel laws/tablets. Switch to standard after the final batch. The final spellbook switch is now an always-visible callout after the trip note, with an explicit altar interaction, a regular-spellbook check and south-entrance recovery for anyone who left on Ancients.

preparation.title: Five inventory loads from the Ruins of Unkah bank
preparation.text: Set up at the Ruins of Unkah: take Ferryman Sathwood's ferry south of Al Kharid bank to Unkah, then use the bank chest in the tent near the docks . Buy five Shantay passes at 5 coins each from the local Shantay guard. Count banked filled waterskins first; the guard also sells waterskin(4) for 30 coins each , so stock up to ten full skins for two per trip. Buy these before loading clay, then bank coins and spare supplies. Load one trip: equip the fire staff and keep a charged ring of dueling equipped if available. Withdraw 23 unnoted soft clay, the air-rune stack, the law-rune stack, two full waterskins and one Shantay pass . That fills 28 inventory slots. The runes can cover the remaining whole batch; each tablet uses one air and two laws, with the equipped staff supplying fire. Walk and craft: leave through Unkah's eastern guarded exit , consuming one pass, then head north around the cliffs to the Ancient Pyramid's south entrance . Enter directly into the altar room and make the current load at the lectern. Stay on Ancients between loads. Bank and repeat: leave through the portal beside the altar and return south by the same route to Unkah's bank. Returning into Unkah does not consume a pass. Deposit the tablets, replace depleted waterskins and withdraw the next clay load and pass. Make four loads of 23, then a final load of 16: 108 tablets over five visits . If you carry extra food or supplies, reduce the clay load and keep going until 108 are banked. The walking loop spends no law runes or Paddewwa tablets on travel.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: After Desert Treasure, prepare these total supplies for all 108 tablets ; stay on Ancient Magicks if it is already active : 108 soft clay in total, withdrawn unnoted in inventory loads 108 air runes 216 law runes for the tablets , plus the travel buffer below Fire staff, equipped while crafting The lectern cannot use noted clay. Air and law runes stack normally, and the completed tablets stack. The banking loop below makes the 108 tablets in five inventory loads . Check existing soft clay first and obtain only the shortfall to 108 soft clay . If you already have bracelets of clay, equip one and mine at an ordinary clay mine such as south-west Varrock or the Isle of Souls. Each fresh bracelet converts 28 ordinary clay to soft clay while mining, so four fresh bracelets cover 112; stop at 108 usable soft clay. Already-enchanted bracelets work while you are on Ancients. Out of cosmic runes, or do not want to enchant bracelets? Bring a pickaxe and mine ordinary clay on the Isle of Souls . Use the Soul Wars minigame teleport or Edgeville's Soul Wars portal, mine the clay rocks south of the lobby, and bank there. If you have vials of water banked, soften the clay at the bank: with an otherwise clear inventory, withdraw 14 unnoted clay and 14 vials of water , use vial water on the clay, then bank the soft clay and empty vials and repeat. Each clay uses one vial of water and returns an empty vial. Use one filled vial for each clay you still need to soften, and check how many vials remain after making potions. Missing filled vials can be bought in 100-vial packs from Aemad in East Ardougne . If you prefer a reusable water container, take an empty bucket from a general store and use the well north-west of Edgeville bank , reached through the Soul Wars lobby portal. Fill the bucket, use its water on one clay, then refill and repeat. Use a bucket for this well method; empty vials cannot be filled directly at wells. With either method, stop at 108 usable soft clay including existing stock . No cosmic runes or spellbook change are needed; any other convenient clay mine also works. Law-rune refill: the earlier 700-law opening stack also funded MTA and travel. Check the bank now, set aside 216 for these tablets , and aim for roughly 350–400 laws in total before the batch, leaving about 134–184 for travel . That is a flexible convenience target; buy only the amount you are missing, and keep cash available for the upcoming cosmic-rune and first battlestaff purchases. The Guild visits in 2.1 provide the next refill opportunity. Where to buy laws: after The Hand in the Sand , use Wizard Akutha's rune shop upstairs in the Wizards' Guild, Yanille if you have 66 Magic, or actual 63 plus a Wizard's mind bomb (+3) . Buy the drink from Falador's Rising Sun Inn if needed and drink just before entering. Laws start at 240 coins each with 250 in stock ; prices rise as stock falls, so allow roughly 80,000 coins for 300 additional laws across reasonably stocked worlds . If you are not yet eligible for the Guild, Ali Morrisane's unlocked catalytic rune shop in Al Kharid sells laws at a flat 300 coins each ; use the rune-shop unlock instructions in 1.3. Refill coins with the existing Wealthy Citizen method if short. At 54+ Magic , use the ancient lectern beside the altar on the fourth level of the Ancient Pyramid while Ancient Magicks is active. After Desert Treasure, the ground-level entrance on the south/back side of the pyramid takes you directly to this room. Before leaving after the final tablet load: pray at the altar beside the ancient lectern to switch from Ancient Magicks back to the standard (regular) spellbook . Check that spells such as Varrock Teleport and High Level Alchemy are back before leaving. Charge Earth Orb and High Level Alchemy need this spellbook; your Paddewwa tablets still work after switching. If you already left on Ancients, return through the pyramid's south entrance and switch at the altar. The Earth-orb grind itself uses only part of the 108-tablet stack , but making the full batch now avoids repeating the spellbook/lectern setup later.

route_steps.review: Quest item requirements, recommendations and quest-local acquisitions checked; local suppliers and bank-shortfall recovery now explicit where needed. After Twilight's Promise, use the existing Tal Teklan quetzal landing, complete Scrambled! with the checked Construction level, and buy only the live cosmic shortfall to 4,900 from Teicuh. The shop stocks 30 at a 50-coin base with small stock markup; allow roughly 250,000 coins for all 4,900 and about 164 fully stocked shop visits, split into sessions. Retain roughly 100,000 working cash if convenient: ten Guild staves plus ten natures cost about 72,000 and ten completed-staff alchs return 93,000. A five-staff/nature start costs about 36,000 plus travel; 100,000 is not a hard gate. Refill live cash with the existing Wealthy Citizen method only when the cosmic gap, chosen starting batch and travel would exhaust it. Fund each next staff batch before the later optional law refill.

preparation.title: Twilight's two combat styles and Scrambled's local materials
preparation.text: Twilight's Promise: take weapons/ammunition for two different combat styles , such as the rune sword and Magic staff/runes, plus food and a teleport. One melee weapon with different attack settings is not two styles. The quest's insignia and related objects are supplied during the quest. Scrambled!: its bowl of water, 2 normal planks, 6 nails, saw and hammer can all be collected during the quest's local tasks; check the nearby marked containers before shopping. Bring combat gear/food and 38 Construction (you trained to 39 above). Keep spare nails if collected because bent nails do not count as completed repairs. These are ordinary planks, not oak planks.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Children of the Sun was completed in 1.2 , so the Varlamore chain is ready. Complete Twilight’s Promise , then take a quetzal to Tal Teklan ; its landing site is already built. With 39 Construction trained above, complete Scrambled! there. Check your cosmic-rune bank and use Teicuh's Tal Teklan Rune Shop to buy only the shortfall to 4,900 cosmic runes total . Cosmic cost and shopping loop: the shop normally stocks 30 cosmics per world , starting at 50 coins each with a small price rise as stock falls. Buy the available stock and hop worlds; allow roughly 250,000 coins for the full 4,900 from zero . That full purchase takes about 164 fully stocked shop visits , with more visits if stocks are depleted. Split the shopping into comfortable sessions and count what you already bought. The orb batch consumes 4,770 cosmics —three per orb—leaving 130 for enchanting and mistakes. Keep cash for the first battlestaff cycle: roughly 100,000 coins left after the cosmic refill is a comfortable working reserve. At the start of 2.1, ten plain battlestaves plus ten nature runes cost about 72,000 coins at the Guild across stocked worlds; attaching the charged orbs and alching those ten returns 93,000 coins to fund the next batch. Smaller starts work too: five staves plus five natures cost about 36,000 coins , before a little travel money. Buy only missing natures for the next batch and let the alchs fund later purchases. Check how many coins you have left after MTA, sand, Magic training and quest purchases. If buying the missing cosmics and your first staff batch would use up the bank, earn more through Wealthy Citizens/house valuables in Civitas illa Fortis . Stop when you can cover those purchases and some travel money. The 100,000-coin reserve is a convenience target; a smaller staff batch can start the cycle. Fund the next staff-and-nature batch before spending extra on the later optional law-rune refill. Before leaving the bank: check the quest-specific quantities and sources in the preparation note.

route_steps.review: Existing resource/level handoff checked against the adjacent quest consumers; do not interpret expected loot as live bank ownership. The final Paddewwa load now switches to standard before leaving the pyramid; this step checks that state and sends only players still on Ancients back to the altar.
route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Check your Magic level and spellbook before charging orbs. MTA, quests and jewellery will have added XP since your last training session. Charge Earth Orb needs 60 Magic on the standard spellbook , and early 2.1 needs unboosted 63 Magic to boost into the Wizards' Guild. If below 63, train to 63 with ordinary elemental combat on safe, low-defence targets or sensible banked High Alchemy, buying runes in small batches; do not spend the nature runes intended for the 2.1 battlestaves without budgeting replacements. You should already be on the standard spellbook after the final Paddewwa tablet load. If still on Ancients, switch at the Ancient Pyramid altar before the first orb trip. Paddewwa tablets remain usable as teleports after switching. Use this repeatable inventory for each trip: Equip an earth staff and a bank teleport such as a ring of dueling. Withdraw 25 unpowered orbs , 75 cosmic runes and 1 Paddewwa tablet . Break the Paddewwa tablet and run through Edgeville Dungeon to the Earth Obelisk . Cast Charge Earth Orb until all 25 are charged. Teleport to a bank, deposit the Earth orbs, restock, repeat. Continue until all 1,590 are charged. Keep the charged orbs banked for the battlestaff and alchemy money-making method in Chapter 2.

route_steps.review: Existing resource/level handoff checked against the adjacent quest consumers; do not interpret expected loot as live bank ownership.
route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Check your unboosted Crafting level and XP after finishing the quests, orbs and jewellery above. Animal Magnetism (+1,000 Crafting), Enlightened Journey (+2,000) and The Hand in the Sand (+9,000) have all added XP. You need 58 Crafting to attach Earth orbs to battlestaves in 2.1. Keep the 1,590 charged Earth orbs and the quest supplies in the checklist below banked for Chapter 2. At 58 Crafting or higher: you can attach Earth orbs to battlestaves in 2.1 without any pie. Skip the pies and any further cap hunting. At 54–57 Crafting, with caps/pies: mushroom pie gives +4 Crafting per bite, enough to reach the required 58 from level 54 or higher. If five caps arrived during Woodcutting, make four pies (and keep one cap spare): mix four pots of flour with water, put the resulting pastry dough in four pie dishes, add one cap to each and bake at a range with your 60 Cooking. Bank the pies for 2.1. If you have fewer, check whether those boosts will last until making battlestaves brings you to 58. If you would rather avoid refreshing a boost, train to 58 using the option below. Below 54, or without enough pies: cut spare banked gems or gather extra sand and soda ash to make and blow glass until you reach 58 Crafting. Leave the Earth orbs and the quest supplies listed below banked. Stop when your skill tab shows 58. You are ready for battlestaves once you have 58 Crafting, or at least 54 Crafting with enough mushroom pies to make the first batches with a boost. Choose whichever option suits your current level and bank.
